directive.quote: Own Workshop main repair and shared tool packaging

old_copy.deleted_with: The original meeting-ledger path is absent from published main; the exact original sequence filter remains in Git history.

preserve: Only ledger lines strictly after the cursor are returned, in their original order.
allowed_deltas: Supply an already read ledger through the same rows parameter instead of reading the old Mac's file.
The record-door adapter projects each heard id's timestamp to seq and unwraps the original row bindings after filtering.
banned_substitutions: Claiming the original cursor filter is a new algorithm.
Including the cursor's own line, reordering rows, or changing the returned row objects.
